questions.stem: What effect does adrenaline have on the body?

options.text: It increases heart rate and diverts blood to the muscles
It causes the uterus lining to thicken
It slows the heart rate and relaxes muscles

questions.explanation: Adrenaline prepares the body for 'fight or flight' by increasing heart rate, breathing rate, and blood flow to muscles. It also causes the liver to release glucose for energy.
